description: Smallest offline pilot for consistency-aware active preference acquisition, using the pre-existing exhaustive real OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) pairwise SciDocs judgments as an offline oracle. No live provider calls, no new judgments, no qrel leakage into acquisition decisions.
proposed_formula: score(i,j) = uncertainty(i,j) * impact(i,j) * (1 + ambiguity(i,j)); cost term omitted (uniform cost, documented, not hidden)
extraction_rule: Copeland score (wins - losses over revealed edges only), tie-broken by BM25 prior score, tie-broken by doc_id. Same rule at every budget for every strategy. No graph repair (MWFAS) in the extraction path.

pre_registered_primary_comparison.strongest_baseline_rule: argmax mean nDCG@10 at the 20%-budget checkpoint, among {random_unobserved, static_adjacent, uncertainty_only, cycle_scc, existing_uht}, computed before inspecting significance
pre_registered_primary_comparison.correction: Holm, family = proposed vs each of the 5 non-oracle baselines at 10% and 20% (10 comparisons)

leakage_controls: acquisition scoring functions (scoring.py) take only the candidate pool, the revealed-so-far Copeland tally, and the qrels-free BM25 prior
qrels are loaded only in oracle.py's QueryOracle.relevance field and consumed only by evaluate.py, never passed to scoring.py or strategies.py
the cached oracle answer for an unrevealed pair is never read until strategies.py selects that exact pair
